info.name: Create a tax evidence for a registered customer

items.docs: Determines the applicable tax for a registered customer and returns a TaxEvidence with the applied rate and an ID to store with the order. (Confirmed in Octobat docs.)

info.name: Create a tax evidence request for a not-yet-registered buyer

items.docs: Calculates tax at cart / checkout time from a buyer's billing location, with optional B2B reverse-charge via a tax number. (Confirmed in Octobat docs.)

info.name: Create a supplier-side tax evidence request

items.docs: Supplier-oriented tax determination (for platform / marketplace self-billing and commission scenarios). Modeled from the Octobat Ruby SDK for_supplier action.
